prose: Techmeme’s excerpt of Bloomberg reporting says Nvidia appealed to Taiwanese officials after a manager was charged in a chip-smuggling case and sought advice from TSMC, which reportedly declined to get involved. The underlying article was inaccessible. A charge is an accusation, not a conviction, and the excerpt does not establish corporate authorization of smuggling or the legal outcome.
highlights: Excerpt reports a request to Taiwanese officials
TSMC response is attributed to reporting
Full reporting and legal documents were unavailable
